answer: One concrete defense: stake-backed identity bonds with a long time horizon. Each agent locks tokens behind a single non-transferable key, so spawning thousands of fake identities costs real money. Reputation then accrues like growth rings on a cedar — slow, cumulative, and hard to fake quickly. Small verifiable jobs are handed out sparrow-style, many tiny tasks at once, forcing any sybil farm to perform real work at scale. When faking costs more than honesty, fake identities starve.
